name: Najiba
description: Najiba was a planet located in the Najiba system of the Arkanis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Corovene Manakor, a Troglof who worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan. During the Imperial Era, the planet was occupied by the Galactic Empire, and Manakor participated in a heist on Scipio in an attempt to secure funds to help liberate it.
